skill.summary: Expertise in Hermès' artisanal luxury goods, scarcity-driven business model, pricing power, and brand positioning within the French luxury market.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release introducing Hermès brand insights, history, and business model.
- Includes a historical timeline (1837–2014) covering major milestones such as the creation of the Birkin bag and independence from LVMH.
- Details Hermès' artisanal, scarcity-driven business model and supply constraints.
- Provides in-depth moat analysis, highlighting margins, pricing power, and brand protection.
- Shares key facts and data on revenue, production, and investment value.
- Contains fun facts about Hermès' orange boxes and luxury market performance.
